validity.railExpiryNote: SEPTA rail zip validity ends 2026-11-21; a refresh tranche is due by 2026-11-14 (queue GATED). This staged asset must be rebuilt from the successor rail zip before any page build ships after that date.

engine.pairingRule: An asset whose meta.service_model is 'set' MUST be loaded only by an engine exposing servicesFor(). The loader (lib/loader.mjs) refuses the pairing loudly otherwise. A legacy (unmarked) asset under this engine is permitted (Detroit-shaped data resolves identically).

presentationDecisionsNotTaken.question: Walk-only journey presentation: PHL11's fastest result is 383 s of pure walking. Whether walk-only results are presented as journeys is Justin's call, taken when a city build approaches presentation.
presentationDecisionsNotTaken.stagingBehavior: The selection module neither filters nor relabels walk-only results. It FLAGS them in its output (presentationFlags.walkOnlyFastest) so the eventual page build surfaces the decision instead of burying it.

constants.adopted: W0-default-T35-P15 — Philadelphia calibration 2026-10-23 (files/calibration-2026-10-23.md), measured on Philadelphia data; a defended tie with Detroit's values
constants.reliabilityForm: v2 (design §3): sum of corridor merged-stream median-gap headways, capped at 60 min, + penalty * transfers

selection.correctnessContract: Ruling 5, structural: the fastest archetype's arrival equals the single-optimum (plan()) baseline exactly, 0 s tolerance, on every pair. Any nonzero delta fails the build verification.
selection.mode: frequency-aware (design-addendum Addendum 3) — the binding selection mode for Philadelphia
